source_observations.quote: Hearing screening indicates bilateral hearing loss. Formal audiometry was completed this week, and the signed audiologist report states that mean unaided threshold in the better ear was 47 dB, averaged over 500, 1000, 2000 and 3000 Hz. The report explicitly confirms removal of both hearing aids during testing and identifies the better ear, so those measurements are distinguished from the driver's account of hearing reasonably well when his aids are working.
